name: Ryota Iwara
source:
Kyoko's son. He secretly lusts after his mother, but tries to hide his feelings, as he knows people wouldn't approve.

After the landlord raises the rent, he starts secretly working for farmer Fukuzawa, in order to help his mother financially.
